profile.constituencyprofile_Text: Kakinada Urban Constituency is located in Kakinada District of Andhra Pradesh. It is not only Constituency Head quarter but also District Head quarter. It is the largest city in the District stand out for their significant contributions to the construction, education, innovation, commerce, and service sectors. These unique advantages position the constituency to achieve an ambitious annual growth target of 15% across all key sectors.Kakinada City has a rich historical and administrative legacy. Established as a municipality in 1866, Traditionally, there was a small village by name “Kakavandivada” situated near the present Kakinada City. But soon after the settlement of Dutch here in their first Establishment, they used to call it as “Co-Canada” which subsequently transformed into “Kakinada” after independence. However, there are several theories in circulation with regard to the origin of the name of Kakinada on the basis of legends history, Logic, Geographical and other factors.

economy_text.economy_Text:
Kakinada City’s Economy at a Glance


The Economic Vision Plan for Kakinada City presents a comprehensive growth strategy to transform the constituency into an economically vibrant, investment- friendly, and employment-driven region. With a Gross Constituency Domestic Product (GCDP) of ₹9,450crores in 2023 24(FRE),Kakinada City is projected to achieve ₹19,259 crores by 2028-29, reflecting a strong and sustainable annual growth trajectory averaging 12-15%. The economic strategy is designed to leverage sectoral strengths, address infrastructure and employment challenges and promote industrial diversification, ensuring inclusive and resilient economic progress.
economy_text.gcdP_Growth_Text: Kakinada City is witnessing steady economic momentum with a targeted 15% annual GCDP growth rate across key sectors like real estate Ownership of  Dwellings, tourism, and Trade, Hotel & Restaurants. This growth trajectory aligns with the long-term vision of making the constituency a vibrant urban and economic hub by 2047.
